name: claimmate
description: Manage business-travel claims with model-based recognition, one editable requirements schema, and auditable finance delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Model-recognized travel claims with one editable policy schema.
interface.longDescription: ClaimMate separates projects, intake, reimbursement requirements, finance delivery, and automation into focused skills. First setup records the user name and email choice, displays the complete three-column reimbursement Scheme, and waits for explicit confirmation before processing files or starting the listener. A large model owns every semantic judgment, including travel scope, expense and material types, amounts, routing, pairing, and special-condition applicability. Deterministic code validates structured outputs, preserves originals, applies concise flat filenames such as EXP-001_机票_1551元_发票, and reconciles each invoice against the sum of one or more payment records. Users maintain only expense type, required materials, and other finance requirements in 报销要求.xlsx. Finance feedback is model-extracted and previewed, then after user confirmation either incorporated into the global workbook or retained as a project-scoped temporary requirement with source and change evidence. Delivery exports an itemized workbook with the stored user name as the default recipient.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $claimmate to coordinate business-travel reimbursement projects, model-assisted intake, the single requirements schema, and finance delivery.
